messages.subject: problem with inla.read.graph
parts:
Dear all,

when I try to open a graph with the inla.read.graph, the inla program closes (windows message: inla.exe have to close). I have searched for an error into the neighbourhood but I don't find anything.  Can anyone help me? I attach a file with the graph.

I use this syntax:

    g <- inla.read.graph("W:/city_subset1.inla")

thank you!

Marc

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: problem with inla.read.graph
parts:
Running in Linux I get the error message below, and line 2970 in the
file has this line:
2969 1 0
Perhaps that line should read
2969 0
to indicate that this node is disconnected from the rest of the graph?
No other nodes are indicated as being connected to that node.
When I make that change, the graph is read without error messages.
(Of course, a disconnected node may lead to practical issues in
estimation...)

/Finn
